assessment: The work details a valuable method of defocus corrected large area cryo-EM (DeCo-LACE). The data-acquisition approach is highly complementary to the research group's previous work of using high-resolution 2D template-matching (2DTM) to identify macromolecular complexes in dense and heterogeneous cellular specimens. Overall, the data presented shows that DeCo-LACE is a solid approach to locating large ribosomal subunits in FIB-lamella at scale.
